text:
𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗕𝗔𝗟𝗟 𝗢𝗙 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗖𝗘𝗡𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗬 🌀

Shane Warne's first Ashes delivery in England: it pitched outside leg and bowled Mike Gatting.
Old Trafford, 4 June 1993. Gatting just stared at it. 😳

#Cricket #ShaneWarne

𝗪𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗲 𝗸𝗶 '𝗕𝗮𝗹𝗹 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗖𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘂𝗿𝘆'! 🌀

👉 Old Trafford, 4 June 1993 – Ashes
👉 Leg stump ke bahar pitch hui, off stump ud gaya
👉 Mike Gatting ko samajh hi nahi aaya kya hua
